jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. jobs.title: DevOps Engineering Intern
jobs.description: About Sonio Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents. Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path. Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence. About the role We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests.
